latest_release.name: v2.16.1 — Bug Fixes
latest_release.body: This minor update focuses on enhancing the app’s stability and fixing issues related to the volume flyout. Thanks to everyone for the quick feedback! ## 📝 Changelog ### Updates & fixes: * The native volume OSD hiding and displaying system has been improved, reducing the chances of both FluentFlyout and the Windows volume indicator randomly appearing at the same time. by @unchihugo in https://github.com/unchihugo/FluentFlyout/pull/1229 * Fixed an issue introduced in the previous update where the volume flyout sometimes steals the current active window's focus (especially noticeable during typing). by @unchihugo in https://github.com/unchihugo/FluentFlyout/pull/1239 * We've temporarily disabled headset and external controls detection for playing or pausing media—introduced in the last update—due to false triggers causing the media flyout to appear randomly. Volume adjustment detection remains unaffected. by @unchihugo in https://github.com/unchihugo/FluentFlyout/pull/1250 * Updated translations across 9 languages (Thanks to @mustafapekacar @Self4215 @ValDesign22 @naturbrilian @max20211410 @oski165 @junior0liveira @3mr9 @AnsonVTo and others on Weblate ❤️) by @weblate in https://github.com/unchihugo/FluentFlyout/pull/1222 ### Code updates (for open source contributors): * Fixed existing code warnings and suppressed auto-generated code warnings in .wapproj. by @unchihugo in https://github.com/unchihugo/FluentFlyout/pull/1232 * Update AboutViewModel.cs translators section. by @RikuZume in https://github.com/unchihugo/FluentFlyout/pull/1228 * GitHub Commits Changelog: https://github.com/unchihugo/FluentFlyout/compare/v2.16.0...v2.16.1 | Version | SHA-256 hash | |---|---| |GitHub Release x64|5e89f346336d1f16a93f9a857c30e478a5f382611527a2c7e6727d02fe181799| ## New Contributors * @RikuZume made their first contribution in https://github.com/unchihugo/FluentFlyout/pull/1228 ## 📦 How to install ⬆️ **The update is live on the Microsoft Store**. 📦 Visit our [download page](https://fluentflyout.com/download/) to get the latest version, or install directly from the Microsoft Store for automatic updates. If you're on ARM64, you can install and use the x64 version.
